brief: An on-call tool assigns a severity to a new incident from its description and the list of affected regions. Rubric: P1 when users cannot complete a core flow (sign in, checkout, or API calls failing) or when three or more regions are affected. P2 when service is degraded (elevated errors or latency, partial failures) but core flows still complete, or when a single region has an outage. P3 when the impact is internal-only, cosmetic, or limited to non-production environments.

input.description: Checkout returns HTTP 500 for every user since 14:02 UTC.
Search p99 latency is up 40%. Requests succeed, results are slow.
Internal admin dashboard renders the revenue chart with the wrong colors.
Public API returning 502 for about 3% of requests, retries succeed.
Scheduled report emails are not being delivered in one region. Other regions are healthy and the app itself is unaffected.
Staging deploys failing on a flaky integration test.
Image thumbnails load slowly on the marketing site. Pages render, thumbnails take 6 to 8 seconds.
